subject: general
question: ______ was conferred the honorary rank of General of the Nepali Army in November 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**General MM Naravane**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **General MM Naravane **was conferred the** honorary rank of General of the Nepali Army** in November 2020. 
 
• **President Bidya Devi Bhandari **bestowed the honorary rank of General of the Nepali Army to Indian Army Chief General M. M. Naravane during a special event, continuing a decades-old practice that highlights the strong links between the two militaries.
 
• During the function at the President's official house 'ShitalNiwas' in Kathmandu, he was also presented with a sword and scroll.
 
• The ceremony was attended by Prime Minister K. P. Sharma Oli, Indian Ambassador Vinay M Kwatra, and other top officials from both countries.
 
• The 1950 tradition demonstrates the strong ties that exist between the two militaries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **In 1950, Gen. K. M. Cariappa** became the first Indian Army chief to be awarded the title.
 
• **President Ram Nath Kovind **made Nepali Army Chief General** Purna Chandra Thapa** an honorary General of the Indian Army at a ceremony in New Delhi in January last year.
 
• **General Manoj Mukund Naravane** is a retired Indian Army general who served as the 27th Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) and the temporary Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee from December 15, 2021, to April 30, 2022.
 
• On December 31, 2019, he took over as COAS from General Bipin Rawat, who had served his term.
